notes.title: The official release date and presentation of update 1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452855/b00e18b1675f79099b128137f8596117a592a0e9.png

Greetings Community,

We hope you are well. From our end, we are excited to share everything that the Version 1.0 Update has to offer.

We have been diligently working since 2019 to present an update of this magnitude, as the first one sets the pace for what is to come quickly and continuously.

For approximately 5 months, we have been quietly preparing this update, revealing little until just a few days ago, or at most, a month ago.

And finally, it's here.

The most anticipated update for us and the entire team.

Below, we will outline what the "Version 1.0 Update" includes:

- Art remastering.
- Redesign of the layout.
- Release of an official, narrative, and visual teaser for the 2023 version, along with a gameplay teaser for the 2022 version.
- Display of over 5/10 title images on Steam and between 10 and 20 Art Concepts on the website.
- Initial release of the DEPRISION page on the Epic Games Store.
- Complete update on Steam.
- Launch of the official DEPRISION website.
- Creation of design branding, including new covers, logos, backgrounds, banners, animations, and more.
- Recorded live presentation with information on platforms such as YouTube, Twitch, and X.
- Engaging marketing strategies, accompanied by branding on all social media platforms.

More information available on the website: deprisiongame.com

You can also access collectednotes: https://bit.ly/48bDsCs

We thank the press and all media outlets.

Thank you very much.

General Management of AleProgramadorStudios S.R.L.
Alessandro Grassini, CEO of AleProgramadorStudios
Jesús Caldera, CTO, Partner, and Technical Leader of AleProgramadorStudios

notes.title: DEPRISION: Live Presentation and Update via X - Don't Miss Out!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452855/451131eb09c00da168e7684416d0b80e49954d86.jpg

Dear Steam gaming community,

We're thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated DEPRISION presentation update is scheduled for March 11, 2024, to be broadcast live via X. Thirty minutes after the presentation, it will be available across all our social media platforms, including YouTube, X, Instagram, TikTok, Steam, our temporary page, and will be distributed to media via corporate email.

This update won't just be an improvement but a complete transformation of the DEPRISION experience.

When we launch the Official Trailer sometime in 2024, it'll be officially presented with an incredible update surpassing the previous one, including availability on the Epic Games Store, our official website, and of course, Steam. This update will be available on all platforms with a completely redesigned layout, including some new features and a much-polished experience. This overhaul will be accompanied by an exciting marketing campaign designed to captivate and excite our audience.

Throughout this process, we commit to maintaining transparent and effective communication on Steam, and our communication channels will be the official means through which we'll share news, updates, and events related to DEPRISION.

We sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest and support during the development of this project. We cordially invite you to join us on this incredible adventure. Add DEPRISION to your wishlist now and get ready to be part of this exciting chapter in our game's history!

Thank you for your continuous trust and support.

Best regards,
AleProgramadorStudios S.R.L.

notes.title: NOW AVAILABLE - NOVEMBER 11 UPDATE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452855/72ba31393151fedb57a451b911d6375c4d5b6ae1.jpg

Hello dear users!

We are very happy to finally be able to share with you the (Teaser Trailer) and (Teaser Gameplay) of the first look of said title.

However, even and for a few more months, the game will be in an Alpha version.

We are working to get to a playable version of the prologue and a modest introduction as soon as possible and in good standards so that all of you can play a demo of the title itself.

We work to have the title finished in the shortest possible time and that they can enjoy a game in the perfect conditions that a consumer deserves!

Both the price of the game and the updates, dlc, and title information, will be made by this means or the company's networks that are below!

You can follow us on Twitter, YouTube and on our website for official versions of the product.

We greatly appreciate all users, thank you very much.

AleProgramadorStudios LLC team.
